reimbursement_policies.evidence: The requested inpatient ventilation/tracheostomy admission category is not named, but this policy broadly bundles routine facility supplies, nursing, respiratory support components, and room-based recovery services into room and board, facility, or procedure reimbursement. For mechanically ventilated or tracheostomy patients, ventilator or CPAP setup/checks, tracheostomy supplies and care, respiratory assessment, suctioning, weaning, and extubation are not separately reimbursed. Ventilator management 94002 and 94003 is allowed once per day when billed by a physician, advanced practice provider, or respiratory therapist. Related outpatient services in the 3-day payment window must be included on the inpatient claim and are not separately reimbursed.

provider_role_restrictions: 94002/94003 by physician, APP, or respiratory therapist

reimbursement_policies.policy_title: Unbundling Adjustments on Clean Claim Reviews
reimbursement_policies.evidence: The policy does not identify this DRG label specifically. For institutional facility claims, the health plan's clean claim review bundles routine or integral supplies and services into room, procedure, pharmacy, laboratory, and operating room charges. Only medically necessary, physician-directed, non-routine items supported by documentation may qualify for separate payment.

pairing_conditions: same room and board acuity level

reimbursement_policies.evidence: General hospital routine supplies/services policy bundles routine room-and-board items, critical care room charges, and many facility personnel services into the facility payment. It does not name the requested DRG pattern, but it indicates these hospital services are not separately reimbursable when included in inpatient or outpatient facility care.

exemptions: medically necessary durable medical equipment required for immediate inpatient or outpatient discharge

reimbursement_policies.evidence: This hospital inclusive charges policy bundles routine room, board, nursing, supplies, equipment, and certain ventilator, CPAP, and surgical-room components into facility reimbursement. No DRG-specific mapping rule is stated, but the policy applies broadly to inpatient and outpatient UB-04 claims.

utilization_limits: one unit per day ventilator or CPAP
